feeds.title: UK Defence Journal
feeds.description: The UK Defence Journal is dedicated to providing impartial and complete coverage of defence matters in the United Kingdom. Our aim is to become an internationally renowned and trusted defence media source. Subscribe to keep up with latest defence news from the UK and key international insight.

feeds.title: Think Defence
feeds.description: Think Defence is a blog about UK defence issues, no campaign, no pretension and no hidden agendas. Subscribe to keep up with with latest news, views, analysis and media covering UK defence and security.

feeds.title: Military History Matters
feeds.description: Military History Monthly is Britain's leading military history magazine that brings you the history of warfare, written by experts. Military History Monthly aims to cover the whole range of military history, all arms, all periods, and all human experience. Get the latest articles from this magazine.

feeds.title: Wars of Louis Quatorze
feeds.description: Wars of Louis Quatorze is a military history blog of the 17th century and the 18th century. Read articles on Great Northern War, English Civil War, military history, Reenactment, and more.

feeds.title: Thin Pinstriped Line
feeds.description: A blog about UK defence issues which tries to put a positive and fresh look at many current matters impacting UK and wider defence.

feeds.title: Defence Equipment & Support
feeds.description: From the procurement of clothes to carriers, food to fighter jets, Defence Equipment & Support ensure our UK military customers - the Royal Navy, the British Army, and the Royal Air Force - have the equipment and support they need to carry out their duties effectively. Read the latest news and updates from DE&S, part of the Ministry of Defence. Follow for the latest from our military acquisition programs for the UK armed forces.

feeds.title: RAF
feeds.description: We work with our UK and international partners to watch the skies, respond to threats, prevent conflict, and provide assistance in an uncertain world. For over a hundred years the Royal Air Force has defended the skies of Britain and projected Britain's power and influence around the world.

feeds.title: Catholic Military Association Blog
feeds.description: We exist to support Catholics in the UK Armed Forces, as well as their families and Catholic veterans. We are a lay association of the faithful whose members cooperate to support Catholicism in the UK Armed Forces. We strive to inspire one-another in the Faith, to grow through prayer and the sacraments, and to offer up our sufferings, persevering together in the universal call to holiness.

feeds.title: The Helion & Co. Military Book Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1996, Helion & Company is the world's leading independent publisher of specialist military history. It produces books on many other aspects of Military History from the Late Medieval period through to the present day.

feeds.title: UK Armed Forces Commentary
feeds.description: UK Armed Forces Commentary offers news, rumors, analysis, and assorted ramblings on the strategies, the missions, the procurement of kits, and the future of the Armed Forces.

feeds.title: BMF Blog
feeds.description: At BMF you can experience the world's best outdoor workout. We are the first in military fitness and the leaders in outdoor training. We've been changing lives since 1999.

feeds.title: Army Service Numbers 1881-1918
feeds.description: Find information about British regimental number research, First World War research, Military research, British Army regiments, Regimental numbering sequences between 1881 and 1918, Regimental number series, and Other rank prisoners of war in 1914.
